entries.summary: Bug#40126952: Fix openSUSE 16 server package account conflicts; Declare user and group virtual provides for mysql and mysqlrouter on; openSUSE 16. Each package already creates its corresponding account; before…
entries.text: Bug#40126952: Fix openSUSE 16 server package account conflicts Declare user and group virtual provides for mysql and mysqlrouter on openSUSE 16. Each package already creates its corresponding account before installing directories owned by that account. This resolves RPM account dependency conflicts during installation. Change-Id: I3e063355206f459246c8da0c99285b8cd8764f1d
